value.rationale: A full 120-point theta-tritangent scheme on a natural degree-one del Pezzo branch curve has a canonical finite-field zeta function. Reconstructing the entire S8 splitting class and every extension count from just three observed integers is a structural finite-arithmetic theorem, with complete classification and a sharp two-versus-three extension boundary realized on smooth examples. This is more than a single computed invariant, while making no claim to recover the curve, its Weil polynomial, or unrestricted W(E8) twists.
